caveats: Legacy DT/RF/BRF/SVM/LR and single-score logistic probabilities were fitted in Overall. Specialty evaluations are subgroup transfers, not newly specialty-trained baselines.
Clinical score component availability changes the denominator; current CatBoost is recomputed on each identical subset for comparison. Single-class subsets have null AUROC/AUPRC.
Current Overall, Medicine and Surgery cohorts are inherited separately; specialty denominators must not be added and treated as the Overall evaluation denominator.
KNN is a new fixed original-default comparator, not HPO-selected and not an accepted main-model replacement. No 2024-driven model selection.
Historical lineage exposure remains unchanged; this additive work accesses no 2025 data.
ci95_scope: Original Stage2a 2000 outcome-stratified patient-group replicates, three requested metrics only; no unnecessary calibration-model fits
